C-20; 31E-NY-3027571; EPSTEIN, JEFFREY; CHILD SEX TRAFFICKING; C/A SA_
                               On 07/23/2019, SDNY advised Epstein was found unconscious in
his jail cell at the Metropolitan Corrections Center (MCC). When the staff was able to revive
Epstein he couldn't recall what happened. His cellmate, Nich Tartaglione, denied knowing
anything about Epstein's injuries and advised he was sitting on his bunk listening to music on
his earphones. Tartaglione is the subject of a C-32 quadruple homicide investigation who has
been approved for the death penalty. Epstein was removed from the cell, was evaluated by the
medical staff and an investigation has been initiated as per MCC SOPs. Epstein was returned
to a cell after being separated from Tartaglione. MCC is evaluating a possible suicide attempt.
